name: Sakurai Yukiha
source:
A female railroad worker who works at Tokyo Station (formerly Central Station). She's also acquainted with Mai, a fellow working woman. Acknowledged by others and even herself, she is quite overly serious, often working at her job without rest… though there are rumours of her being occasionally seen walking alone at night.

[i]"—Hold on, Mai. Don't make a fuss on the station premises."[i]
